# Test data

`spec.json` is the list of examples from the CommonMark Spec, version 0.31.2, downloaded unmodified from <https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/spec.json>.

The CommonMark Spec is Copyright (C) 2014-16 John MacFarlane and is released under the Creative Commons CC-BY-SA 4.0 license: <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/>.

`gfm_spec.txt` is the GitHub Flavored Markdown Spec, version 0.29-gfm (2019-04-06), and `gfm_extensions.txt` is cmark-gfm's extension test file. Both were downloaded unmodified from the cmark-gfm repository at commit `27d942c8b0a62d192f616e5bf3578f4b6a89e180`:

- `gfm_spec.txt`: <https://github.com/github/cmark-gfm/blob/27d942c8b0a62d192f616e5bf3578f4b6a89e180/test/spec.txt>
- `gfm_extensions.txt`: <https://github.com/github/cmark-gfm/blob/27d942c8b0a62d192f616e5bf3578f4b6a89e180/test/extensions.txt>

The GitHub Flavored Markdown Spec is based on the CommonMark Spec by John MacFarlane, and both files are released under the Creative Commons CC-BY-SA 4.0 license, as their front matter states: <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/>.

Don't edit or reformat these files. To update one, download the new version and replace it whole.
